title: Excel: Copilot Agent Mode editing for workbooks stored on the device
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents protection for labelled or encrypted files on local storage when they are open in Office, contrary to the briefing's stated gap. The service description also identifies Edit with Copilot as requiring the Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, so the briefing should distinguish that published entitlement from unpublished local-file-specific terms.

claims.claim: Copilot honours usage rights on data encrypted with Microsoft Purview Information Protection.
claims.quote: When you have data that's encrypted by Microsoft Purview Information Protection, Microsoft Copilot honors the usage rights granted to the user.

claims.claim: This encryption can be applied by sensitivity labels or by Information Rights Management.
claims.quote: This encryption can be applied by sensitivity labels or by restricted permissions in apps in Microsoft 365 by using Information Rights Management (IRM).

claims.claim: How sensitivity labels and encryption apply to a workbook on the device is not yet documented.
claims.quote: When a labeled or encrypted file stored outside Microsoft 365 (for example, on local storage, a network share, or another cloud service) is open in an Office app, Copilot honors the same protection settings.
claims.fix: Replace 'How that applies to a workbook on the device is not yet documented.' with 'When a labelled or encrypted file on local storage is open in an Office app, Copilot honours the same protection settings.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/architecture-data-protection-auditing. Remove 'and how do sensitivity labels and encryption apply to it' from the processing open question.
